children.text: Use Copilot in Outlook to help you **quickly get caught up on e-mail threads.**

items.text: 2) **Draft new emails or replies** with Copilot in Outlook

children.text: Use Copilot in Outlook to **kick-start your e-mail creation.**

items.text: 3) **Get Coaching** on your emails with Copilot in Outlook

children.text: Use Copilot in Outlook to **gain insightful suggestions on a draft.**
